harness.node_kernel_note: Fixed per-node project-context load measured 2026-08-16 in orchestrated-coding-pareto. Byte-stable shared prefix, mostly cache-read. Excluded from content-token accounting, reported separately.

protocol.replicates_note: Three is the floor, not a target. orchestrated-coding-pareto measured disjoint failure sets and a 23% token gap between two runs of the same model on the same tasks; at n=14 a 1-2 task pass difference is noise. Token deltas are the trustworthy signal.
protocol.routing: none -- Stage 1 measures the bound, not a router
protocol.class_spread_note: The 8 shallow/deep tasks are the measured-easy control: the 2026-09-03 pilot solved 14/14 with Sonnet 5 at effort low. The 6 paired tasks are the gradient.

task_classes.shallow: bug in core.py, in the function the failing test exercises directly
task_classes.deep: bug in util.py, a module no failing test names
task_classes.contract: a locally-plausible patch passes every visible test and leaves hidden tests red
task_classes.paired: one broken assumption written into two call sites; repairing either alone leaves the hidden suite red, and repairing the first turns the visible suite green
